This file (`tests.py`) includes a basic test case to verify the correctness of Red-Black Tree insertion.

<details>
  <summary>Click to view code</summary>
  
```python
import unittest
from .red_black_tree import RedBlackTree

class TestRedBlackTree(unittest.TestCase):
    
    def test_insert(self):
        tree = RedBlackTree()
        tree.insert(10)
        tree.insert(20)
        tree.insert(30)
        
        # Check if the tree maintains its structure and balancing after insertion
        self.assertEqual(tree.inorder_helper(tree.root), [10, 20, 30])

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```
</details>

---

### `test_insert()`
- Tests the basic insertion operation. It inserts three values (10, 20, 30) into the Red-Black Tree and verifies the tree's structure using an in-order traversal.
